environment.description: Spring Boot 3.1 application deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with no origin access restrictions. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to port 8080. The upload directory /var/app/uploads is served by an nginx sidecar on port 80 with default configuration (executes .jsp/.php if handlers are present). No WAF rules applied. Security group allows inbound 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.network: ALB -> EC2:8080, SG allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 8080 and 80
config.upload_serving: nginx serves /var/app/uploads with autoindex on, no content-type restrictions
